units.source_text: 「哎呀……」堀木表現出一副大孝子的模樣，對老母親畢恭畢敬，過於客氣的話語有些不自然，

en.t: "Oh my..." Horiki put on the manner of a devoted son, bowing and scraping before his old mother, and his overly polite speech sounded somewhat unnatural.

units.source_text: 「謝謝媽媽，是年糕紅豆湯嗎？太奢侈了呀，

en.t: "Thank you, Mother. Is this sweet red-bean soup with rice cakes? How extravagant.

units.source_text: 您不要這麼費心啦，因為我們有事馬上就要出去呢。

en.t: You really should not have gone to so much trouble, since we have business and must go out right away.

units.source_text: 不過，您特意做了最拿手的年糕紅豆湯，不吃也太可惜了，那我們就吃吧。

en.t: Still, since you went to the trouble of making your special red-bean soup, it would be a shame not to eat it, so let us have some.

units.source_text: 你也來一碗，這可是我老母親特意做的啊，啊，真好吃，太奢侈啦。」

en.t: You have a bowl too. My old mother made this especially for us. Ah, it is delicious. What luxury."

units.source_text: 堀木喜笑顏開，吃得津津有味，完全不像在演戲。

en.t: Horiki beamed with delight and ate with obvious relish, looking nothing at all like he was acting.

units.source_text: 我也吃了幾口，卻聞到了開水的味道，

en.t: I too took a few bites, but I smelled the odor of boiled water,

units.source_text: 嚐了一口年糕，覺得味道不對勁，是我從未有過的味覺。

en.t: and when I tasted a piece of rice cake, something seemed wrong; it was a sensation of taste I had never experienced before.
